product_summary: Newsletter ad network and sponsorship marketplace where advertisers book native placements across thousands of vetted newsletters, and publishers monetize inventory; includes programmatic ad network, self-serve campaign tooling, verified audience stats and an MCP connector.
current_data_sources: Publisher-created marketplace listings (opt-in newsletters available for sponsorship)
ESP-verified subscriber counts, open rates and click rates (Paved Verified badge)
Advertiser reviews and recommendation scores per newsletter
Publisher-declared audience demographics, job titles and household income
First-party campaign delivery and click reporting from the Paved Ad Network

api_or_integration_evidence.quote: With the Paved API, you can view site details, sponsorship details, creative, and reporting.
Search for newsletters, book sponsorships, submit creative, track campaigns, and handle billing

newsletter_capability_detail: Paved has deep first-party newsletter data, but only for newsletters listed for sponsorship in its own marketplace, with stats verified through publisher ESPs: "Verified newsletter statistics, including subscriber count, open rates, and click rates." Its glossary defines the Marketplace as "a directory where we list thousands of premium newsletters with available sponsorships" - i.e. opt-in sponsor-ready inventory, not a cross-platform index.
verified_gap: Coverage is limited to Paved's own opt-in marketplace inventory (thousands of sponsor-ready newsletters) plus point-in-time publisher/ESP stats. Nothing in their public docs describes indexing publications that never list on Paved (Substack, LinkedIn, Ghost, Mailchimp) or tracking publication growth/momentum over repeated snapshots.

likely_buyer_role: Head of Ad Network / VP Marketplace Partnerships (advertiser-side data and inventory expansion)
caveats: Paved is simultaneously a prospect, a channel and a partial competitor: it already holds sponsor relationships and campaign performance for its own inventory, so NF must be sold as outside-in coverage (publications not on Paved, sponsor mentions read from article text) rather than as better marketplace stats. API docs are split advertiser/publisher and are thin on discovery endpoints.
